findings_for_the_next_market: the press feed admits about one row per ~100 reads; sponsor rosters about one per ~280; every other class admitted none
marketplaces anonymise listings by design: a for-sale signal never names its company — closed, not re-tried
rosters pay in reads only where the listing carries the city on its face; of 45 roster-class sources probed in Florida, none did
registry, vacancy, association and fraud sources answered (or refused) without a company list on their face; Sunbiz and the WARN list refuse this reader
completion costs about 5 reads per finished row against ~100–280 to discover one: start a market from the rows on file
decide the size rule before the run: private revenue at this size is not published on free routes
